== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 13 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of March 1, 2017” (PDF made 31 May 2017): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf source], preserved copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].
